specs.source_title: Introduction to Bambu Lab Build Plates | Bambu Lab Wiki
specs.locator: Build Plate Types › 3D Effect Sheet tab › paragraph 1
specs.quote: Currently, four patterns are available for selection: diamond, starry, galaxy, and carbon fiber.
specs.note: The four patterns the 3D Effect Sheet comes in, listed word for word. Read from a sentence of the tab's descriptive paragraph (the same paragraph as the part.surface_treatment row), not from a table or a specification row, so unverified (§C.6: a value from prose stays unverified). This full combo carries all four: its only Texture option value is "Carbon Fiber+Diamond+Galaxy+Starry" (the same four names as structured store data), and the store overview says "There are 4 exciting textures, ranging from Carbon Fiber all the way to Starry, Galaxy, and Diamond!". Product scope because the Texture group has this one value.

specs.value: Spring steel plate with a 3D effect transfer sheet
specs.source_title: How to replace the Bambu 3D Effect Sheets | Bambu Lab Wiki
specs.quote: Step2: Place the Sheet and the spring steel plate on the Fixture tool
specs.note: Construction read from the sheet-replacement steps, not from a specification row, so unverified: the sheet is laid on the spring steel plate (Step2), has an adhesive film on its back (Step4: "Peel the adhesive film on the back half way off") and is a "Transfer Sheet" (Step7); the plates wiki says the same ("applying the 3D effect spare sheet only on the official steel plate from Bambu Lab"). Neither the film's material nor a steel grade is published.

specs.quote: 4. The 3D Effect Plates are considered consumables.
specs.note: Stated for the plates on the store page; read from prose, so unverified (§C.6). The plates wiki says the same of the spare sheets ("The 3D Effect Spare Sheets are considered consumables."). No life figure (prints, hours) is published. The deterministic layer does not parse the Considerations prose, so the store page has no row for this key and nothing conflicts.

documents.title: How to replace the Bambu 3D Effect Sheets (video guide)
documents.text: How to replace the Bambu 3D Effect Sheets (video guide)
documents.note: Embedded in the replacement wiki as <oembed url="https://youtu.be/7XuxrBK58Nk">; written in the canonical watch form because youtu.be is not a document host. Not fetched (offline).

notes: Option groups: Compatibility (X1/P1/A1/X2/P2 = 749063516274991104, A1 mini = 749063516274991105) and Texture (one value, Carbon Fiber+Diamond+Galaxy+Starry = 749063516274991107). Manifest sku_codes and value_labels are empty for this handle. Each Compatibility value is a compat.statement row; sizes are scoped to the Compatibility values; nothing differs by texture.

The combo carries all four textures (the Texture value), but no checked source states how many plates or sheets the box holds, so contents.pieces and package.contents are not_published and in_the_box is empty. No source states a package weight or package size either (package.* not_published).

Construction stated only in prose: laser-formed optical textures on a transfer film (plates wiki; the part.surface_treatment row, unverified) on a steel plate (plates wiki: "the official steel plate from Bambu Lab"; replacement wiki Step2: "Place the Sheet and the spring steel plate on the Fixture tool"; the part.material row, unverified). The film's material is not named.

Slicer setting, not a spec: "Please set the plate type to Smooth PEI/High Temp Plate" (wiki and store). Heatbed settings per filament on this plate (store: PLA 60~65℃, TPU 35~45℃) have no registry key for a plate (print_settings.* is filament-only); they are kept as the quotes of the PLA and TPU relations.

Caveats kept as notes only: lidar calibration does not work as expected on the reflective film (wiki: X1 series; store: skip lidar calibration or calibrate with a regular plate); X1/X2/P2 users should disable build plate position detection (store variant note, already written by the deterministic layer); keep the surface clean with hot water and detergent, do not touch it, take care with a scraper.
Fixture-tool 3MF files on wiki.bambulab.com are not listed as documents (the document registry classifies a wiki-host link as kind "wiki", not "model_file", and they belong to sheet replacement).
No hex (not a filament). The runner derives the product type from the route (one level: accessory) while the manifest says build_plate; every key used here applies to both accessory and plate.
